name: Hattori Hanzou
source:
The Tokugawa Shinobi Group Leader who is known as the strongest ninja history has ever known.
He is a former Iga Shinobi who had left the village at the age of 12 to serve the Tokugawa household. From the moment he was born he was educated thoroughly to be a shinobi.
Always calm and collected, if it's for the mission he will not hesitate and be ruthless.
